# Hash-pinned lock of requirements-dev.txt (which pulls in requirements.txt
# too), for the tools you need to build and test this app but that never
# ship in it: PyInstaller and pytest.
#
# Regenerate after changing requirements-dev.txt or requirements.txt:
#
#   .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m piptools compile --generate-hashes
#   --allow-unsafe --no-header
#   --output-file=requirements-dev.lock.txt requirements-dev.txt
#
# --allow-unsafe: setuptools comes in transitively (PyInstaller needs it) and
# pip normally refuses to hash-pin it, on the theory that a project shouldn't
# pin its own build tooling. This one isn't managing setuptools as a build
# backend, just installing it as an ordinary dependency, so pinning it is
# exactly what --require-hashes needs to work at all.
#
# See requirements.lock.txt's own header for what --require-hashes buys you
# and what it doesn't.
